findings.current: You could imitate the outside, but what was inside never changed.
findings.defect: The source explicitly contrasts an imitable shell with the unchanging essence inside it. “The outside” conveys the contrast but drops the shell image that the accepted baseline preserved.
findings.rationale: 껍데기 means “shell” here, set against 본질, the essence within.
findings.replacement: You could imitate the shell, but the essence within never changed.

summary: The assembled English is faithful overall, with one minor loss of a source image preserved in the accepted baseline.
